description: This file defines the SugarWidgetFieldBool class, which extends SugarWidgetReportField and provides methods for filtering, displaying, and input handling of boolean fields within the SuiteCRM application. It is specific to handling boolean type widgets in report views and list displays.

classes.name: SugarWidgetFieldBool
classes.description: A class that extends SugarWidgetReportField to handle boolean field widgets in reports and list views within SuiteCRM. It includes methods for filtering queries, rendering list displays, and generating input forms for boolean fields.

methods.name: queryFilterEquals
methods.description: Generates SQL conditions for filtering records where the boolean field equals a specified value ('yes' or '1' for true, null or '0' for false).

methods.name: displayListPlain
methods.description: Creates HTML for displaying the boolean value as either an icon or a checkbox in list views, utilizing application strings for boolean states.

methods.name: queryFilterStarts_With
methods.description: Alias for queryFilterEquals, used to filter boolean fields based on starting characters, though functionally identical here.

methods.name: displayInput
methods.description: Generates HTML select input for boolean selection, with options for 'Yes', 'No', and default, for use in forms.
